title: plugin-approvals: support a platform/org-independent approver type
body:
## Problem

`plugin-approvals` resolves every approver through **organization-scoped membership**. In `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`, `expandApprovers(step, record, organizationId)` handles approver types `user` / `field` / `team` / `department` / `role` / `manager` — and all of the group/role paths query `sys_member` / `sys_team_member` / `sys_department_member` filtered by `organization_id`.

There is **no approver type for a platform-level (org-independent) approver group** — e.g. "anyone in the platform `admin_full_access` permission set", which has `organization_id = NULL`.

## Impact

Platform-level approval use cases can't express their approver without hardcoding literal user ids:

- **Marketplace listing review** (ADR-0025): the reviewer is a *platform admin* (unscoped `sys_user_permission_set` → `admin_full_access`), not a member of any one org. See cloud `docs/design/marketplace-review-on-approvals.md` — this is the blocker for using the approval engine's approver resolution for marketplace review.
- Any future platform/control-plane approval (e.g. publisher onboarding, payout release) has the same need.

Today the only workaround is approver type `user` with literal platform-admin user ids baked into the node config — brittle (breaks when the admin set changes) and not declarative.

## Proposed solution

Add a platform-scoped approver type, e.g. `platform_admin` (or a generic `permission_set` type with an optional `org-independent` flag):

- Resolve it by querying `sys_user_permission_set` rows with `organization_id IS NULL` that point at a named permission set (default `admin_full_access`), independent of any org.
- Make it composable with the existing types (a step can mix org-scoped and platform approvers).
- Keep it opt-in; existing org-scoped behaviour unchanged.

Reuse the same "unscoped permission-set = platform admin" definition already used elsewhere (cloud `package-review.ts isPlatformAdmin`, and `plugin-auth` `customSession`).

## Acceptance criteria

- An approval step can declare a `platform_admin` (org-independent) approver and `expandApprovers` resolves it to the set of platform-admin user ids without an `organization_id` filter.
- Existing org-scoped approver tests pass unchanged.
- Works when `organizationId` is null/absent (platform context).

## References
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` (`expandApprovers`)
- cloud `docs/design/marketplace-review-on-approvals.md` (dependent use case)
- Related: framework#1518 (durable suspended runs) — the other enabler for the full flow-orchestrated marketplace review
